    Key Strategic Takeaways

    • Japan and Mexico show strongest composite launch fit based on demand, paid conversion and B2B potential.
    • India offers massive long-term scale and high B2B distribution (9/10), but lower consumer paid conversion (3/10).
    • Focus initial GTM on enterprise and nearshoring segments where evidence confidence and employer subsidies are highest.
    • Monitor unscored watchlist markets (Costa Rica, Kazakhstan) as secondary expansion options once local validation is verified.
    ⚡

    Recommended Next Steps

    1. Deep dive into top 3 markets (Japan, Saudi Arabia, Mexico) using detailed evidence dossiers.
    2. Review evidence dossiers and regional acoustic/payment nuances before launching localized pilots.
    3. Validate segmentation and GTM for enterprise vs. direct-to-consumer routes to insulate unit CAC.
    4. Build pilot plan and success metrics with local enterprise partners for initial cohorts.
    5. Export filtered data for executive briefings and cross-functional review.
